isOpen.description: Controls whether the panel is visible

target.description: The element the panel is anchored to (typically event.currentTarget)

onClose.description: Called when the panel should close: close button, Escape key or a click outside the panel and the target

children.description: Panel content. Scrolls when it is taller than maxHeight

title.description: Heading shown at the top of the panel. Also used as the accessible name of the panel

footer.description: Content shown below the body, typically action buttons

placement.description: Where to place the panel relative to the target. 'auto' picks the side with enough space

width.description: Panel width on desktop. Numbers are treated as pixels

maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the scrollable body on desktop. Numbers are treated as pixels

showCloseButton.description: Shows a close button in the header

closeOnOutsideClick.description: Closes the panel when clicking outside the panel and the target

closeOnEscape.description: Closes the panel when Escape is pressed

autoFocus.description: Moves focus into the panel when it opens and restores it when it closes. Set to false for panels opened on hover

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name of the panel when no title is provided

className.description: Additional CSS class for the panel
